test_item_verbatim: When LTM_OperationalModeSts.Info pass into "Ignition_Pre_Off: LTM stops to read the Rear_Camera.Data it stops to copy the Rear_Camera.Data into Rear_Camera_Repetition.Data Rear_Camera_Enable.Info="False". LTM sets RVC_ACTIVE=True internal variable.

tcs.tc_title: all vehicles,    $ adb shell dumpsys media.camera
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. CAN source: BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts (637, 2261, 376)
4. PENDING: DR-CAM-i the CmdIgnSts value that corresponds to Ignition_Pre_Off is not sourced
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK)
2. Read the NormalCameraDaemon log
   $ adb logcat -d -s NormalCameraDaemon
3. Read the camera service status and check that no Rear_Camera data path is open
   $ adb shell dumpsys media.camera
tcs.expected_result:
1. BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK) is sent and the HU leaves the RUN power state
2. The NormalCameraDaemon teardown entry is present in the log
3. No Rear_Camera data path is open and no camera data is copied
tcs.test_item:
When LTM_OperationalModeSts.Info pass into "Ignition_Pre_Off: LTM stops to read the Rear_Camera.Data it stops to copy the Rear_Camera.Data into Rear_Camera_Repetition.Data Rear_Camera_Enable.Info="False". LTM sets RVC_ACTIVE=True internal variable.

(all vehicles,    $ adb shell dumpsys media.camera)

reasoning: 驗證目標為點火離開 RUN 後 NormalCameraDaemon 停止讀取 Rear_Camera.Data 並關閉資料路徑，即 SYS-RA-VF551_V33-220 之 "Ignition_Pre_Off" 轉態。關鍵情境條件為已完成初始化之 RUN 態，再將 CmdIgnSts 降為 1 (IGN_LK)（VAL_ 逐字取自 PDT27_E2A_R1_FDCAN8.dbc BO_ 1153）。**`Ignition_Pre_Off` 對 `CmdIgnSts` 之值對應查無來源** —— 於 VF551_V33／V42／V2 三本 SYS2 全文搜尋同時含 `OperationalModeSts` 與 `CmdIgnSts`／`IGN_LK` 之列，零命中；依 CAM-03 審閱 §二-9 標 PENDING: DR-CAM-i，`1 (IGN_LK)` 為待證之暫用值。verbatim 仍取 V33 —— SWE-CAM-001 之來源中無任何 V2 或 CFTS092 條文描述關機序列（見 -001 之互參說明）。本列與 NR1L-RVC-001 同 req_id，依 §8.3 mode 軸拆為開機／關機兩 sibling。
